text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a p99 latency spike for text generation in eu-west starting ~09:02 UTC. p95 rose from ~150ms to ~420ms, p99 to ~820ms. Affected route: /v1/generate (model=redwood-1-large). Customers hitting timeouts. @oncall
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-3205002468 — auto-triage assigned to eng-oncall
anya: I'm taking this. grabbing traces and flamegraphs now.
sam: Looking at infra metrics — rw-eu-1-gpu01 pool queue depth up, router CPU ~90%, epoll wait high. No deploys in last 2h.
leo: Checking runtime traces: KV cache hit rate down 24% over the last 10m, lots of small batched requests causing cache churn. Also saw increased kernel preemption on some nodes.
maria: Support — any repro payloads from customers?
jordan: Got one from ACME corp. Repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","prompt":"<long chat history>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```
They hit it with 40 concurrent connections.
anya: Thanks. Quick mitigations to try (prioritized):
 1) Enable tenant-level circuit breaker for noisy keys (shed long requests over 60 qps) — low-risk.
 2) Route heavy traffic from eu-west to fallback model (redwood-1-medium) in us-east for critical tenants.
 3) Apply short-term rate limiting/quota bump controls for enterprise keys (or throttle non-SLAs).
 4) Warm KV cache on rw-eu-1 by prefetching common prefixes.
 5) If needed, spin up extra instances in rw-eu-1 pool (auto-scale override).
sam: I'll flip the circuit-breaker threshold and add the routing rule. Doing step 1+2 now.
sam: ran:
```bash
# enable per-tenant cb
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/configs/circuit-breakers \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"env":"eu-west","threshold_qps":60,"action":"shedule-fallback"}'
```
sam: cb toggled, routing rule pushed to edge. Observability: shedding ~18% of requests to fallback model, router CPU down 15%.
leo: After CB/routing change, p95 -> ~260ms, p99 -> ~360ms for eu-west. :thumbsup: 
maria: Also applied request-level rate limits on two noisy API keys: key_ak_03, key_ak_21. Throttled to 40rps.
jordan: Customers report fewer timeouts, SCs still seeing higher tail but improved.
anya: Next: leo + runtime team will push a KV-cache warmup and a small prefill optimization - target 2h.
leo: Opening PR to adjust prefill and reduce eviction churn, will QA in staging then prod roll within 1.5h.
maria: We'll create an incident ticket + postmortem. Action items:
 - Runtime: KV cache prefill fix (owner: leo)
 - Infra: autoscale policy review for eu-west pools (owner: sam)
 - Devex: add automated playbook steps to run CB/reroute (owner: anya)
 - Support: collect detailed customer repros and attach logs (owner: jordan)
Also adding SLO guardrail change proposal: decrease p99 alert threshold from 600ms -> 450ms for eu-west during business hours.
anya: Adding to playbook: explicit commands for CB toggle, admin API snippet, and recommended fallback models/regions. playbook link: <https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/latency-fallbacks>
maria: Good work. I'll keep monitoring; will update when we close the incident. :warning: 
sam: Closing note: revert routing when capacity recovers, and schedule planned capacity bump if this trend continues.
jordan: Noted. I'll notify affected customers and provide an ETA.
maria: Incident resolved? follow-up scheduled for postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-3205002468 updated: status=mitigated, owners=[anya,sam,leo]
